info.title: gamekit
info.description: GameKit CLI — 'gamekit migrate' and (stub) 'gamekit admin create'. Installed as a dotnet tool.

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

commands.name: create
commands.description:
Create an admin user (interactive or flag-driven). First admin auto-promoted to
superadmin.

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --username
options.description:
Username (3-32 chars,
case-insensitive). Prompted
when omitted
without echo when omitted on a
TTY. Falls back to env
GAMEKIT_ADMIN_PASSWORD in
non-TTY contexts

options.name: --password
options.description:
Password (>= 8 chars). Prompted
without echo when omitted on a
TTY. Falls back to env
GAMEKIT_ADMIN_PASSWORD in
non-TTY contexts

options.name: --role
options.description:
admin      Role: admin or superadmin.
Ignored for the first admin
(auto-promoted to superadmin)

options.name: --connection-string
options.description:
Postgres connection string
(gamekit_owner role
recommended)

commands.name: db
commands.description:
Database backup and restore helpers (wraps pg_dump/pg_restore). Prerequisite:
pg_dump and pg_restore must be on the operator's PATH.

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

commands.name: backup
commands.description:
Backup Postgres to a file via pg_dump (--format=custom). Optionally issues a
Redis BGSAVE. pg_dump must be on the operator's PATH.

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --connection-string
options.description:
Postgres connection string. Falls back to
GAMEKIT_MIGRATIONS_CONNECTION /
GAMEKIT_CONNECTION

options.name: --output
options.description:
Absolute path for the pg_dump output file
(e.g. /srv/backups/game.pgdump). Required

options.name: --redis-connection
options.description:
Redis connection string (e.g.
localhost:6379). When supplied, issues
BGSAVE to snapshot Redis

commands.name: restore
commands.description:
Restore Postgres from a pg_dump custom-format file via pg_restore. Requires
explicit --database to prevent accidental restore into the wrong DB. pg_restore
must be on the operator's PATH.

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --connection-string
options.description:
Postgres connection string. Falls back to
GAMEKIT_MIGRATIONS_CONNECTION /
GAMEKIT_CONNECTION
dump file to restore. Required

options.name: --file
options.description:
Absolute path to the pg_dump custom-format
dump file to restore. Required

options.name: --database
options.description:
Explicit target database name. Required —
prevents silent restore into the wrong DB
(T-17-04-03)

commands.name: migrate
commands.description:
Apply GameKit Core migrations against the configured Postgres
(backwards-compatible shorthand; for all packages use 'gamekit migrations
apply').

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --connection-string
options.description:
Postgres connection string (gamekit_owner
role recommended for migrations)

commands.name: migrations
commands.description:
Multi-package migration status and apply tooling (DR-04/DR-05). Covers all 6
GameKit packages in canonical order: Core, Auth, Admin, Rankings, Matchmaking,
Lobby.

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

commands.name: apply
commands.description:
Apply pending migrations across all packages. Use --dry-run to print idempotent
SQL without executing any DDL.

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --connection-string
options.description:
Postgres connection string (gamekit_owner
role recommended for migrations)

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
Print idempotent SQL for all packages
without executing any DDL

commands.name: list
commands.description:
List applied and pending migration counts per package in recommended application
order.

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --connection-string
options.description:
Postgres connection string (gamekit_owner
role recommended for migrations)

commands.name: service-token
commands.description: Service-account bearer token operations (issue, revoke, list).

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

commands.name: issue
commands.description:
Mint a new service-account bearer token. Raw token printed once — store it
securely.

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --name
options.description:
Label for this service token (e.g.
"game-server-prod"). Must be unique
P30D) or UTC datetime (e.g.
2027-01-01T00:00:00Z)

options.name: --expires
options.description:
Optional expiry as ISO-8601 duration (e.g.
P30D) or UTC datetime (e.g.
2027-01-01T00:00:00Z)

options.name: --connection-string
options.description:
Postgres connection string. Falls back to
GAMEKIT_CONNECTION env var

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all service-account bearer tokens (names, dates, status — never the hash).

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --connection-string
options.description:
Postgres connection string. Falls back to
GAMEKIT_CONNECTION env var

commands.name: revoke
commands.description: Revoke a service-account bearer token by name.

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --name
options.description: Label of the service token to revoke

options.name: --connection-string
options.description:
Postgres connection string. Falls back to
GAMEKIT_CONNECTION env var
